limitations: Disposition aggregate_only: a retrospective single-practice case series of 47 patients (51 treated knees) that reports only cohort-level counts, means, rates and paired statistics and describes no individual patient, so no patient records are created and cohort statements are not copied to placeholder patients.

reported_individual_count is 47, the literal number of unique patients in the patient-level cohort; roster_complete is false because none of the 47 individuals is enumerated or described individually.
Cohort age is stated as a mean of 75 years in the abstract and 74.6 years (SD 12.7; range 44-94 years) in the Cohort characteristics section; treated as rounding, not a source conflict.
The abstract gives 28 women and 19 men while the Cohort characteristics section gives 28 (59.6%) female patients; these agree (47 patients) and are cohort statistics, not individual facts.
Table 2 compares the cohort with literature values for other treatments (including published TKA change scores); those are literature statements, not data on this cohort.

Figures 1-3 are cohort-level plots; per-patient lines and bars are pixel content with no printed per-patient values and are recorded only as qualitative shape in visual.json. No plot estimates were taken.
No supplementary material is listed in the article XML.
